answer: Each identity binds to one hardware attestation quote at registration and must present a fresh quote every 9 epochs; a chip that signs for two identities burns both seats. Forging 220 identities costs 220 real chips plus the registration bond, while one honest agent needs a single device it already owns. The forge test is the live device, the zenith test is the locked stake, and the sable test is the graded history no template can fake.
